causal_session_mapping.execution: first eligible joint US/London trading session strictly after the relevant US maturity/decision

currency_execution.broker_fx_conversion_if_needed: separate operational cost; not silently ignored
currency_execution.condition: orders funded from an available USD balance and placed using instrument currency
currency_execution.preferred_path: SP2 USD -> SMH.GB USD -> SP2 USD

historical_rule.detector: S&P500/IVV drawdown from previous running ATH
historical_rule.hold_clock: anchored by first actual delayed entry
historical_rule.normal_state: 100% physical SP2 plus separate accumulated reserve
historical_rule.source_execution: signal close T -> source execution T+1

physical_sp2.recovery_exit_repurchase: restore current pre-existing SP2 composition; if SP2 was fully sold, use current causal SP2 composition, not automatic 50/50 unless the canonical monthly membership rule independently requires a set-change rebalance
physical_sp2.recovery_funding_sales: sell current SP2 holdings proportionally by market value

recovery_entry_state_machine: sell physical SP2 proportionally by current market value
do not borrow or create synthetic leverage
buy recovery UCITS immediately only with cash that broker rules make available for trading
if SP2 sale proceeds are not yet reusable, residual purchase waits according to settlement-safe policy
recovery_exit_state_machine: sell recovery UCITS according to frozen H378 exit
use available proceeds to rebuild physical SP2 according to current causal SP2 composition
if sale proceeds are not immediately reusable, residual SP2 repurchase follows settlement-safe policy
reserve remains separate from normal SP2 exposure

reserve.dividends: after applicable dividend tax/withholding cashflow, net dividends are not automatically reinvested into the stock
reserve.tb3ms_role: historical causal economic return proxy only
uses: remaining capital continues earning reserve carry

settlement.next_required_test: settlement/fill-lag falsification plus broker account-level confirmation of sale-proceeds reuse

tax.mechanism: reserve provides tax-payment liquidity so strategy can avoid some forced sales of physical SP2

preferred_operational_candidate.reason: same UCITS fund as previously validated execution candidate; USD trading currency matches physical US SP2 sale proceeds and can avoid explicit EUR/USD conversion during crash rotations
